summary: Galiano Gold Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE American, furnished a Form 6-K covering its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, together with CEO and CFO certifications and a November 5, 2026 news release. No transaction, stake, price per share, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly reporting package; balance sheet shows cash of $86.8M, restricted cash of $25.9M and total assets of $765.0M. Not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
